title: Contract criteria cover behavior, docs, and code quality

criteria.statement: The ingestion endpoint forwards a valid record without changing its fields.
criteria.hollow_delivery: The endpoint accepts the request but silently drops or rewrites a field.
criteria.check: Run the ingestion endpoint behavior test.

criteria.acceptance_criterion: An API consumer submits a valid record and handles each validation failure from the reference alone
criteria.statement: An API consumer, reading only the API reference, constructs a valid record submission and recovers from each documented validation failure without reading source.
criteria.hollow_delivery: The reference is touched but an API consumer still cannot construct a submission or handle a failure from it alone — or no reference change lands at all.
criteria.check: Reviewer performs the primary submission and one failure recovery following only the API reference.

criteria.statement: Record validation continues through the shared validator path.
criteria.hollow_delivery: A second validator is added for this endpoint only.
criteria.check: Inspect tests and code paths for one validation entry.
